user.title: Add AIPAI device
user.description: Search your network for lights, or add one by serial number.

search.title: Search for lights
search.description: Scanning your network for AIPAI lights. Detected subnet(s): {detected}. Leave as-is to scan your Home Assistant network, or enter one or more subnets (comma-separated, e.g. 10.42.1.0/24) to scan instead.

pick.title: Choose a light
pick.description: These lights answered on your network. Pick one to add, and give it a name if you like (you can rename it later).

manual.title: Add AIPAI device by serial
manual.description: Enter the device's serial number (from the AIPAI app's device list, e.g. 12345678) and its type. Only 'Light' is verified against real hardware; the other types are experimental and unverified. Model is optional and applies to lights only.

error.invalid_serial: Serial number should be digits only.
error.no_subnet: Enter at least one subnet to scan, e.g. 10.42.1.0/24.
error.none_found: No lights answered on that network. Make sure the lights are powered on and on the same network, then try again — or add one by serial.
error.all_configured: Found only lights that are already added.
error.unknown: That light is no longer available; please scan again.

data.local_control: Local control (talk to the light on your LAN, no vendor cloud)
